title: Monsanto pays Agent Orange veterans compensation

tellings.quote: In the mid1 1980s, Monsanto was required to pay millions in compensation to veterans of war who had been exposed to the highly toxic chemical

plain: In the mid-1980s, according to Michels, the chemical company Monsanto had to pay millions in compensation to war veterans exposed to Agent Orange, a highly toxic chemical. He tells it himself, without naming a source, in an episode about the dark past of big drug and chemical companies, as an example of companies harming the people they were supposed to serve.
